# DEM fixtures for the pure-Rust GeoTIFF reader

Small GeoTIFFs for `crates/owd-format/tests/geotiff.rs`. `expected.json` holds what rasterio 1.5.2
(GDAL 3.12.2) reads from each file. Both are made by `tools/make_dem_fixtures.py`.

| File | What it covers | Source and licence |
|---|---|---|
| `f32_strip_none.tif` | stripped, uncompressed float32, UTM 30N | generated by the script; Apache-2.0 (this repository) |
| `f32_tiled_deflate_pred3.tif` | tiled, DEFLATE, floating-point predictor, partial edge tiles | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `f32_strip_deflate.tif` | stripped DEFLATE, 5 rows per strip | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `i16_strip_lzw_pred2_nodata.tif` | int16, LZW, horizontal predictor, nodata -32768 | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `i16_tiled_lzw.tif` | tiled LZW with a partial right-edge tile (see the note in `src/geotiff.rs`) | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `f32_nan_nodata.tif` | float32, NaN nodata | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `f32_mercator_nodata.tif` | float32, EPSG:3857, LZW + predictor 3, nodata -9999 | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `f32_geographic.tif` | float32, EPSG:4326, arc-second pixels | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `f32_pixel_is_point.tif` | PixelIsPoint raster (half-pixel origin shift) | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `f64_strip_none.tif`, `u16_strip_deflate_pred2.tif` | other sample types | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `glo30_n05_w003_clip.tif` | an 80 x 80 pixel clip of a real Copernicus GLO-30 tile (N05 W003, Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire), PixelIsPoint, EPSG:4326, DEFLATE | see below |
| `warp_expected.json` | not a raster: what rasterio 1.5 reads from a warped (UTM 30N, 10 m, bilinear) copy of `f32_geographic.tif` at 150 UTM points, and the warp's own interpolation error. Made by `tools/make_warp_fixture.py`; used by `tests/geographic_dem.rs` | generated; Apache-2.0 |
| `refuse_*.tif` | files the reader must refuse: ZSTD, PackBits, two bands, a rotated transform, no georeferencing | generated; Apache-2.0 |

## Copernicus GLO-30 clip

Cut from `Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N05_00_W003_00_DEM.tif`, from the public Copernicus DEM open-data
archive (`copernicus-dem-30m` bucket), pixels 1500 to 1580 across and 1700 to 1780 down. The full tile
(50.7 MB) is not in the repository. The clip is under 22 KB.

Produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH
2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.

The Copernicus DEM licence allows this use (free of charge, worldwide, including redistribution
with the attribution above). The clip is test data only.

To rebuild it, download the tile yourself and run
`python tools/make_dem_fixtures.py --glo30 <tile.tif>`.
